title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Raspberry Mojito Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Raspberry Mojito Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit captures the crisp, cooling flavour of a classic cocktail-inspired blend. Sweet, tangy Raspberry provides a juicy berry burst on the inhale, while a delicate layer of Mint brings cool herbal freshness, rounded off with a touch of lime for added zesty sharpness. The result is a lively, refreshing vape with a flavour as vibrant as its name. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made specifically for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods lock in magnetically and are fully compatible with the twist-to-switch pod system for effortless flavour swaps. With two pods per pack, Raspberry Mojito makes an excellent partner to fruit, menthol, or citrus blends.
